Southeast Michigan Nonprofits

Source: IRS Exempt Organizations Business Master File, Michigan file, saved when this page was built. 501(c)(3) organizations with ZIP codes 480 to 483, without hospitals and medical care organizations. Revenue comes from each organization's latest filing on record, so years differ, and many small organizations report zero. Years are counted from the IRS ruling on tax-exempt status, which can be later than the founding. Map positions are ZIP code centers from the Census Bureau. Missions, websites and staff counts come from e-filed Form 990s, so very small organizations may have none. Technology titles are limited to the officers and highest paid staff listed on the form. Revenue history for the 400 largest organizations comes from ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer.
